title: Effects of Localized Gene Expression Disruption on Mouse Limb Development via siRNA Injection
author: Yea, Onggo, et al.
materials: Falcon® 60 mm TC-treated Center Well Dish

steps.title: Fabricate and assemble microinjection syringe
steps.instruction: Prepare a glass micropipette and attach it to a 5 µL syringe for siRNA injection.

substeps.instruction: Pull capillary glass tubes bidirectionally to create two tapered tips.
Fracture the sealed tip gently with sterile forceps to open a channel.
Attach the broken‑tip micropipette to a 5 µL syringe using flexible tubing.
Seal the syringe‑tubing junction with Parafilm (or equivalent) to prevent leakage.
Confirm flow and suction by drawing trypan blue into the needle as a visual tracer.

steps.title: Cut support mesh for explant culture
steps.instruction: Prepare a stainless‑steel mesh piece to support hindlimb explants in culture dishes.

substeps.instruction: Cut the stainless‑steel mesh into a 2.2 cm × 2.2 cm square.

steps.title: Set up explant culture dishes
steps.instruction: Prepare culture dishes with pre‑warmed media and saline, and place the support mesh.

substeps.instruction: Warm BGJb medium supplemented with 1 % Antibiotic‑Antimycotic (complete medium without serum) at 37 °C for 20 min.
Pre‑warm PBS at 37 °C for 20 min.
In a sterile organ‑culture dish with a central well, add 2 mL of pre‑warmed saline to the outer moat.
Add 2 mL of pre‑warmed complete medium (CM) to the central well.
Place the sterilized, pre‑cut stainless‑steel mesh over the central well to support the tissue.
If contamination is suspected, briefly immerse the mesh in 70 % ethanol, then allow it to air‑dry completely before use.

steps.title: Dissect and isolate E12.5 hindlimbs
steps.instruction: Harvest embryonic hindlimbs from a pregnant mouse and keep them sterile for culture.

substeps.instruction: Disinfect the dissection surface with 70 % ethanol and line it with an absorbent pad inside a sterile hood.
Place the euthanized pregnant mouse supine on the clean surface and disinfect the abdominal skin with 70 % ethanol.
Lift the skin with forceps and make an incision through the abdominal wall to expose the uterus.
Excise the uterine horn and immediately transfer it into PBS.
Wash the uterus twice in fresh PBS to remove blood and debris.
Isolate embryos from the uterine tissue using fine scissors while submerged in PBS.
Transfer embryos into a clean dish containing fresh PBS.
Under a dissection microscope, make a transverse incision at the lumbar region with a #15 blade and collect the lower body containing hindlimbs.
Separate each hindlimb at the hip joint using a scalpel.
Place hindlimbs onto a filter and transfer them to a Petri dish for injection, handling tissue gently to avoid pinching or excessive manipulation.

steps.title: Prepare siRNA‑Lipofectamine injection mix
steps.instruction: Create the siRNA‑Lipofectamine RNAiMAX complex immediately before injection.

substeps.instruction: In a sterile microcentrifuge tube, combine 1 µL of Sox9 siRNA (100 pmol/µL) **or** the appropriate negative‑control or fluorescent‑control siRNA with 2 µL of Lipofectamine RNAiMAX (total volume = 3 µL).
Gently pipette‑mix the solution without vortexing.
Use the complex within 5 minutes of preparation; do not let it sit longer to avoid aggregation.
Avoid freeze‑thaw cycles of siRNA stocks to maintain knockdown efficiency.
